exposure: Type of intrapartum care provider (midwife vs. obstetrician)
outcome: Use of intrapartum medical interventions (labor induction, augmentation, pain medications, epidural analgesia, intravenous fluids)
Use of nonpharmacologic pain relief measures
cohort: 1421 women who had vaginal births from the Listening to Mothers in California survey
finding: Women with midwife birth attendants were less likely to report experiencing intrapartum medical interventions and pressure for epidural analgesia, and more likely to report encouraged decision-making.
